<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="2" class="hinge numeric-choices"><div class="hinge-question"><p>Two lines have non-parallel direction vectors. <div class="booklet-cue">Additional diagnostic question</div>

::: {.notes}
Correct option 2. The only parameter pair compatible with x and y fails the z equation; non-parallel directions then establish skewness. Distractor 1 checks only x and y. Distractor 3 equates “do not intersect” with “parallel”. Distractor 4 assumes independent parameters must have equal values. Ready: Example 3.15. Divided: compare the two resulting points and revote. Needs explanation: return briefly to the skew visual, match x and y, then compare heights. Use the shared simultaneous 1–4 fingers routine. Default 60 seconds, adjustable timer, Start/Pause/Resume, Reset and separate answer reveal. Expiry must not reveal the answer.
:::
